name: @uxuiprinciples/mcp-server

tools.name: get_principle
tools.description: Get a UX/UI principle by its slug: metadata, summary, the bibliographic citations behind it (author, title, year, url) and a link to the full research-backed guide on uxuiprinciples.com. With UXUI_API_KEY set (pro mode) the full guide body comes back in `content`. Use this to identify, summarize or cite a specific principle.

tools.name: search_principles
tools.description: Search UX/UI principles by query, part, difficulty, or tags. Returns matching principles with summaries.

query.description: Search query (searches title, slug, summary, and tags)

tools.name: list_principles
tools.description: List all UX/UI principles or filter by part. Returns principle summaries and available parts.

part.description: Filter by part name or ID

tools.name: get_principle_prompts
tools.description: Get the AI prompts for a specific principle. With UXUI_API_KEY set (pro mode) the prompt texts come back in `prompts`; without it the prompts belong to the paid Principles Library and the tool returns the URL of the guide. Call get_principle first if you only need the summary.

tools.name: get_smell
tools.description: Get a UX smell (anti-pattern) by ID with symptoms, fix recipe, and related prompts.

tools.name: list_smells
tools.description: List all UX smells (anti-patterns) optionally filtered by category.

tools.name: detect_smell
tools.description: Detect potential UX smells based on a description of UI issues. Returns matched smells with confidence levels and suggested fixes.

description.description: Description of the UI issue or user complaint (e.g., "users say the dashboard is too cluttered and they don't know where to start")

tools.name: suggest_fix
tools.description: Get a fix suggestion for a UX issue. Detects the smell and provides step-by-step fix recipe with a refactoring prompt.

issue.description: Description of the UX issue to fix

smell_id.description: Optional: specific smell ID if already known

tools.name: get_flow
tools.description: Get a user flow with pre-flight and post-flight checklists. Use before designing or shipping a flow.

id.description: The flow ID. One of: "onboarding", "forms", "pricing", "dashboard", "empty-states", "checkout", "settings", "navigation", "search", "authentication", "notifications", "data-tables". Call list_flows for the current set.

tools.name: list_flows
tools.description: List all available user flows with their target metrics.

tools.name: generate_checklist
tools.description: Generate a pre-flight or post-flight checklist for a specific flow. Returns both structured data and markdown.

phase.description: Which checklist to generate: preflight (before design) or postflight (before ship)

tools.name: get_flow_principles
tools.description: Get the key principles and common smells for a specific flow.

tools.name: audit_interface
tools.description: Audit a described screen or flow: returns findings mapped to principles and UX smells, each with severity, remediation and business impact, plus a score, the detected interface type, strengths and the three priority fixes. Pro mode only (UXUI_API_KEY set): the audit runs on the uxuiprinciples.com API. Without a key use detect_smell then suggest_fix, which run offline.

description.description: What the screen shows and what users do or complain about, 20 to 5000 characters. Name the components, the actions and the states you implemented (loading, empty, error, confirmation).

context.description: Where the interface lives. Echoed in the result; does not change the rules.

depth.description: quick: top 5 findings. full: every finding.

instructions:
Provides 195 research-backed UX/UI principles, 12 UX smells (anti-patterns)
with fix recipes, and 12 user-flow checklists (onboarding, forms, pricing, checkout,
navigation and more), in English and Spanish.

Use search_principles / list_principles / get_principle to ground UI decisions in
evidence. Use detect_smell or suggest_fix when a UI has a described problem. Use
get_flow / generate_checklist before designing or shipping a known flow.

All tools are read-only. get_principle carries the citations behind each principle.
Free mode: the full guide bodies, the 600+ AI prompts and audit_interface need
UXUI_API_KEY set to a Principles Library key (uxuiprinciples.com/en/developers).
Everything else runs offline from the bundled dataset.
